SOLAN URBAN DEVELOPMENT & WATER SUPPLY AUTHORITY (SUDWSA)
REVENUE & BILLING ENFORCEMENT DIVISION
ZONAL CIVIC COMPLEX, BLOCK-C

Notice Ref: SUDWSA/REV-DUES/2026/0442
Date of Notice: October 18, 2026

FINAL DEMAND NOTICE: OUTSTANDING WATER & SEWERAGE CHARGES

To:
The Secretary / Authorized Representative
M/s Green Valley Cooperative Housing Society
Account ID: W-98441 / Zone-3 North
Solan Metro Area

Subject: Notice of Outstanding Assessment for Financial Year 2026-27

1. SUMMARY OF DUES:
According to the computerized billing records of SUDWSA, the semi-annual water
supply and bulk sewage maintenance charges for the billing cycle ending
September 30, 2026 remain unpaid.

- Principal Water Assessment: INR 38,000
- Infrastructure Cess: INR 4,500
- Total Dues Payable: INR 42,500 (Forty-Two Thousand Five Hundred Rupees)

2. MANDATORY PAYMENT DEADLINE:
Payment must be completed in full on or before:
PAYMENT DEADLINE: November 20, 2026.

3. CONSEQUENCES OF NON-PAYMENT:
If the amount is not received by November 20, 2026:
- A late payment surcharge of INR 2,500 will be automatically levied.
- Water supply connection may be subject to disconnection under Section 41(A)
  after 7 calendar days' formal notice.

4. MODE OF PAYMENT:
Payment may be remitted via the municipal online portal at
https://sudwsa-fictional.gov.in/pay or via Demand Draft in favor of
"SUDWSA Revenue Account" at the North Zone Cash Office.

5. GRIEVANCE & DISPUTE RESOLUTION:
If you have already deposited this amount or wish to contest this assessment,
you may file a written representation within 15 calendar days from the date of
this notice with the Revenue Officer.

Authorized Signatory:
V. M. Choksi
Revenue Officer (Zone-3)
Solan Urban Development & Water Supply Authority
Email: revenue-desk@sudwsa-fictional.gov.in
